verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote desktop and game-streaming tool, not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and call external tools. Plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. No evidence shows Parsec has any MCP-client or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
